concepts.prompt: A short polearm pike: straight honey-brown wooden haft with leather grip wrap in the lower half and copper bands, topped by a two-prong copper fork head like a lightning rod with a small side blade, chunky and friendly rather than menacing. Style: Palworld / Animo-class stylised game asset, chunky simplified readable silhouette that reads at 15 metres, slightly oversized key shapes, soft hand-painted PBR materials, warm natural palette taken from the reference key art (honey wood, warm brass and copper, slate blue, teal, mustard, moss green, cream). Single isolated object only, floating on a plain flat light-grey background, no ground, no shadow scene, no character, no body, no hands, no mannequin, no text, no logo. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon, no crimson, no pink anywhere. Show the same object from three views: front, three-quarter and side, consistent design.
references: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MJohnsonWellabe/Tetherbound/main/docs/reference/tetherbound-meadows-keyart.png (1536 x 1024 source re-encoded as JPEG q90 at 1536 px; local derived file keyart_1536.jpg): project palette and stylised finish
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 1, front-three-quarter): honey-wood haft with sage and cream grip wrap and copper bands, two-prong copper fork head with a brass collar and a small brass side blade; view 0 was edge-on

reference_inspection: Reference inspected before any prompt was written: docs/reference/tetherbound-meadows-keyart.png (Meadows key art: stylised Valheim/Palworld-like realism, honey timber, slate-blue roofs, moss greens, warm brass; its palette strip includes two oxblood swatches reserved for Team Tether, so every prompt banned red, oxblood, maroon, crimson and pink explicitly). Each prompt named the object only, on a plain background, with no character body or hands.
style_block: Every prompt ended with the shared style block: Palworld/Animo-class stylised game asset, chunky simplified silhouette readable at 15 m, soft hand-painted PBR, warm natural palette from the key art, single isolated object on plain light-grey background, no ground/character/body/hands/mannequin/text/logo, absolutely no red/oxblood/maroon/crimson/pink, three consistent views.
